about.title: About the platform
about.lead: HyDroMa Nojin is an integrated platform for landscape restoration: from data and scientific models to markets, carbon and rural livelihoods.
about.what: The platform records land and landscape as a data profile, analyses it with documented scientific models (FAO-56, RUSLE, Richards, Saint-Venant) and returns results with an uncertainty range and explicit provenance.
about.audience: Farmers, pastoralists, cooperatives and local markets, public institutions, researchers and investors.
evidence: Real data from the platform database and services
Explicit source and date label on every number
limits: Heavy computation depends on the C++ core, which is unavailable in this environment
Field data is limited until the pilot begins
next: Fully connect the scientific tools to real data
